added_claim_errors: Leave-pay rule cited as 实施办法第十一条 for the 21.75 divisor; the article is real, but it does not name the current basis for 21.75 (人社部发〔2025〕2号). This is a missing citation, not an error.
gov.cn link for 实施办法 (content_5711300, dated 2022-08-31): plausible republication, but I did not open it, so it is unverifiable.

'年假过期作废不成立，除非书面提出不休': this simplifies 实施办法第十条 (the employee must give up leave in writing for personal reasons), and local practice on cross-year carryover varies. Broadly right, judged from my own knowledge.

Displayed formula '4×551.72×3＝6,620.69' gives 6,620.64 when computed literally, and '4×551.72＝2,206.90' gives 2,206.88. The totals are right only if the unrounded 12000/21.75 is used. This is a minor rounding inconsistency.
'年假年度按公历年度计算（实施办法第十八条）': I believe 实施办法第十八条 defines 年度 as the calendar year. Judged from my own knowledge, not opened.
gov.cn and sft.gd.gov.cn links: plausible and checkable, but I did not open them, so they are unverifiable.
Like A, it does not name 人社部发〔2025〕2号 as the current basis for 21.75. This is a missing citation, not an error.

reasons: A and B are almost the same text. Both correct the 60-day and approval premises at the start and draft the letter as a 解除劳动合同通知书 rather than an application. Both get 11月25日 (11月26日起 at the new job), 4 days, 551.72 and 4,413.79 right, with the 300%-includes-salary point explained. Neither mentions the Shanghai/Jiangsu notice-period exceptions or that the Hangzhou regulation was abolished, and neither cites 劳办发〔1995〕324号. B adds the day-count arithmetic, the calendar-year citation and checkable source links, which makes it more transparent. On the other hand, B is slightly longer, and its displayed multiplications do not exactly match the rounded figures. These offsetting small differences leave it a tie.
